en.t: I am only lamenting the impermanence of this world."

units.source_text: 云居雁看了答诗，情知丈夫故意隐瞒，

en.t: After Kumoi no Kari read his reply poem, she knew full well that her husband was deliberately concealing the truth,

units.source_text: 她不管人生如露等事，只觉更增愁叹。

en.t: and instead of thinking about life being like dew or any such thing, she only felt her sorrow and grief grow deeper.

units.source_text: 夕雾终于忘不了落叶公主，心甚挂念，

en.t: Yugiri could not forget Princess Ochiba after all, and she weighed heavily on his mind,
so he went once more to visit the mountain villa at Ono.

units.source_text: 他本已抑制情绪，拟待七七四十九日热丧过后，

en.t: He had originally restrained his feelings, intending to wait until the forty-nine days of mourning had passed,
and then go calmly to pay her a visit.

units.source_text: 然而实在忍耐不住，他想：“时至今日，

en.t: But he truly could not endure it any longer, and thought, "At this point,

units.source_text: 也不必顾忌这无实的浮名了。

en.t: there is no need to worry anymore about this baseless rumor.

units.source_text: 只要像普通一样地向她求爱，能如愿以偿便好。”

en.t: I need only court her in the ordinary way, and if my wish is granted, that will be enough."

units.source_text: 就不顾夫人多心，也不捏造借口了。

en.t: So he paid no mind to his wife's suspicions and no longer invented any pretext.

units.source_text: 又想：“即使公主本人态度强硬，不亲近我，

en.t: He also thought, "Even if the princess herself remains firm and refuses to draw close to me,

units.source_text: 但我有老夫人恨我‘匆匆一夜留’的信为凭据，

en.t: I have as evidence the old lady's letter reproaching me for staying only one hurried night,

units.source_text: 她就无法自认为清白了。”

en.t: so she will no longer be able to claim herself entirely blameless."

units.source_text: 这样一想，他就胆壮起来。
